name: HRTS 5351
title: Topics in Human Rights Practice
description: Seminar on topics in theoretical and practice-based knowledge and skills related to human rights. Topics vary by semester. May be repeated with a change of topic to a maximum of nine credits. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: Instructor consent. Students may not receive credit for a topic in HRTS 5351 if they have previously passed HRTS 3540 with the same topic.
